projectBackground.name: Regional Rail Upgrade — Curve Realignment
projectBackground.context: A curve is being realigned for 100 km/h. The timetable team wants more trains per hour.

manager.name: Ingrid Solberg
manager.note: Trains don't forgive approximations. Calculate, then check, then plan how nobody gets hurt doing it.

assignment.title: Design the curve and plan the possession
assignment.brief: Calculate cant, braking distance and capacity, then plan a safe possession.

tasks.title: Equilibrium Cant
tasks.prompt: C = 11.8 x V² / R (V in km/h, R in m, C in mm). V = 100, R = 800. What is C (mm)?
tasks.reasoning: Cant balances centrifugal effect for passenger comfort.
tasks.tip: Apply the cant limit and deficiency rules.
tasks.mistake: Using R in km gives nonsense.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Braking Distance
tasks.prompt: s = v² / (2a). v = 30 m/s, a = 0.9 m/s². What is s (m)?
tasks.reasoning: Distance grows with the square of speed.
tasks.tip: Use service, not emergency, deceleration for planning.
tasks.mistake: Using speed in km/h without converting is wrong.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Line Capacity
tasks.prompt: Headway is 4 minutes. How many trains per hour per direction?
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Ballast
tasks.prompt: What is one main role of ballast?
options: Distribute load and provide drainage and track stability
tasks.reasoning: Ballast spreads loads and keeps track geometry.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Possession Safety
tasks.prompt: Select elements of a safe track possession.
options: Working without protection if it is short
Briefing and sign-on of all staff
tasks.reasoning: Possessions need protection, control and communication.
tasks.mistake: Short jobs are where accidents happen.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Possession Plan
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-5 sentence summary of the possession plan.
tasks.modelAnswer: The possession runs 01:00-05:00 Saturday with the line blocked and protected by signals and track circuit clips at both ends. A named Person in Charge will brief all staff and sign them on; work stops 30 minutes before handback for inspection. The realigned curve will have 147.5 mm equilibrium cant and be speed-limited until geometry is verified. Handback requires sign-off by the Engineering Supervisor.
tasks.reasoning: A good plan gives times, protection, responsibilities and handback.
tasks.mistake: Plans without handback checks create incidents.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Unprotected Gang
caseStudy.background: A short track job was done without protection. A train passed and a worker was seriously injured.
questions: Why did short jobs skip protection?
caseStudy.solution: Vertex made protection planning mandatory for every job regardless of length.

options: Protection and a person in charge
